title: G3: Custom cards in lesson format; move buildProgram into lesson-core (M; supersedes E14 SIE-576777)
description:
Supersedes E14 (SIE-576777): carry its scope here.
Acceptance:
- Given a lesson, a custom (saved) card can be a step input and a goal output in lesson.yaml.
- buildProgram lives in lesson-core and is shared by CI and the browser.
- Saved cards round-trip to the Gallery.
- E14 is closed or linked as superseded.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kept and re-parented to RM W2 (SIE-eb52a0): custom cards in lessons are needed by c1/08. Implemented by SIE-0f5f0d.

right_now_summary: Custom cards now work in lessons, and buildProgram is shared through lesson-core.
